reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Michigan
    Focus year: 2021

    Question modeled:
    "In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that criminal activity
     was committed by someone else, and they reported the criminal activity to law enforcement?"
*/

% -----------------------------
% Basic helpers (no modules)
% -----------------------------

is_yes(yes).
is_no(no).

% Deterministic boolean-like helper.
bool(Goal, yes) :- call(Goal), !.
bool(_Goal, no).

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (the question)
% -----------------------------

state(michigan).
focus_year(2021).

person(tenant1).
person(landlord1).
person(third_party1).

tenancy(tenancy1).
tenant_of(tenant1, tenancy1).
landlord_of(landlord1, tenancy1).

premises(premises1).
premises_of_tenancy(premises1, tenancy1).

eviction_action(action1).
plaintiff_in_action(landlord1, action1).
defendant_in_action(tenant1, action1).
action_about_tenancy(action1, tenancy1).
action_kind(action1, summary_proceeding_for_possession).
action_claimed_basis(action1, alleged_criminal_activity_on_premises).

% The criminal activity was committed by someone else (not the tenant).
criminal_incident(incident1).
incident_on_premises(incident1, premises1).
incident_committed_by(incident1, third_party1).
incident_not_committed_by(incident1, tenant1).

% Tenant reported the criminal activity to law enforcement.
tenant_reported_to_law_enforcement(tenant1, incident1).
report_about(incident1, third_party_crime_not_landlord_code_violation).

/* Scenario summary predicate required by prompt:
   succeeds when the encoded factual statement is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    state(michigan),
    focus_year(2021),
    eviction_action(Action),
    defendant_in_action(Tenant, Action),
    plaintiff_in_action(_Landlord, Action),
    action_claimed_basis(Action, alleged_criminal_activity_on_premises),
    criminal_incident(Incident),
    incident_committed_by(Incident, SomeoneElse),
    SomeoneElse \= Tenant,
    incident_not_committed_by(Incident, Tenant),
    tenant_reported_to_law_enforcement(Tenant, Incident),
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic "statute_*" predicates)
% ------------------------------------------------------------

/* ============================================================
   MI Comp L  554.601b (2021)
   Release from rental payment obligation due to domestic violence,
   sexual assault, or stalking with required notice/documentation.
   This statute is about rent-obligation release (not an eviction defense
   based on "someone else committed a generic crime"), but we encode it.
   ============================================================ */

% The statute applies only to leases entered into/renewed/renegotiated after the amendatory act.
% We model it as a fact that must be asserted for a given tenancy; absent such a fact, it fails.
statute_554_601b_applies_to_tenancy(_Tenancy) :-
    fail.

% Covered danger categories.
statute_554_601b_covered_danger(domestic_violence).
statute_554_601b_covered_danger(sexual_assault).
statute_554_601b_covered_danger(stalking).

% Documentation types listed in  554.601b(3).
statute_554_601b_documentation_type(valid_personal_protection_order).
statute_554_601b_documentation_type(valid_probation_or_parole_order_protective_conditions).
statute_554_601b_documentation_type(police_report_charges_filed_within_14_days).
statute_554_601b_documentation_type(police_report_charges_filed_more_than_14_days_with_verifiable_threat).
statute_554_601b_documentation_type(qualified_third_party_verified_report).

% A tenant qualifies for release from rent obligation if all statutory conditions are satisfied.
% We keep it generic and strict; scenario provides none of these facts.
statute_554_601b_rent_obligation_release(Tenant, Tenancy) :-
    statute_554_601b_applies_to_tenancy(Tenancy),
    tenant_of(Tenant, Tenancy),
    % Must have reasonable apprehension of present danger from a covered danger.
    has_reasonable_apprehension_of_present_danger(Tenant, Danger),
    statute_554_601b_covered_danger(Danger),
    % Must submit written notice by certified mail and documentation.
    submitted_notice_by_certified_mail(Tenant, Tenancy),
    submitted_documentation(Tenant, Tenancy, DocType),
    statute_554_601b_documentation_type(DocType),
    % Must vacate before release takes effect.
    vacated_premises(Tenant, Tenancy),
    !.

% Placeholders for conditions not present in this scenario (fail unless facts are added).
has_reasonable_apprehension_of_present_danger(_Tenant, _Danger) :- fail.
submitted_notice_by_certified_mail(_Tenant, _Tenancy) :- fail.
submitted_documentation(_Tenant, _Tenancy, _DocType) :- fail.
vacated_premises(_Tenant, _Tenancy) :- fail.


/* ============================================================
   MI Comp L  600.2918 (2021)
   Damages for unlawful interference with possessory interest (lockouts, etc.).
   Not directly about "criminal activity defense", but encoded.
   ============================================================ */

% Enumerate acts that qualify as unlawful interference under  600.2918(2)(a)-(g).
statute_600_2918_interference_type(force_or_threat_of_force).
statute_600_2918_interference_type(removal_or_retention_or_destruction_of_personal_property).
statute_600_2918_interference_type(lock_change_without_keys).
statute_600_2918_interference_type(boarding_premises).
statute_600_2918_interference_type(removal_of_doors_windows_or_locks).
statute_600_2918_interference_type(termination_of_essential_service).
statute_600_2918_interference_type(introduction_of_noise_odor_or_other_nuisance).

% Exceptions under  600.2918(3)(a)-(d) and (5).
statute_600_2918_exception(acted_pursuant_to_court_order).
statute_600_2918_exception(temporary_for_repairs_or_inspection_as_provided_by_law).
statute_600_2918_exception(good_faith_abandonment_after_diligent_inquiry_and_rent_unpaid).
statute_600_2918_exception(death_reentry_requirements_met).
statute_600_2918_exception(occupant_is_forcible_entry_or_trespasser).

% A tenant has a claim under  600.2918(2) if owner interfered unlawfully and no exception applies.
statute_600_2918_unlawful_interference_claim(Tenant, Owner, Premises, InterferenceType) :-
    tenant_in_possession(Tenant, Premises),
    owner(Owner, Premises),
    interference_occurred(Owner, Premises, InterferenceType),
    statute_600_2918_interference_type(InterferenceType),
    \+ interference_exception_applies(Owner, Premises),
    !.

% Placeholders for scenario-irrelevant facts.
tenant_in_possession(_Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
owner(_Owner, _Premises) :- fail.
interference_occurred(_Owner, _Premises, _Type) :- fail.
interference_exception_applies(_Owner, _Premises) :- fail.


/* ============================================================
   MI Comp L  125.530 (2021)
   Rent suspension/escrow when certificate of compliance withheld/suspended,
   unless hazard caused by occupant; and effect on actions for rent/possession.
   ============================================================ */

% Rent duty is suspended when no certificate or certificate suspended (after reasonable time),
% unless hazard conditions were caused by the occupant(s).
statute_125_530_rent_suspended(Premises) :-
    ( certificate_withheld(Premises)
    ; certificate_suspended(Premises)
    ),
    owner_had_reasonable_time_to_apply_for_temp_certificate(Premises),
    \+ hazard_caused_by_occupant(Premises),
    !.

% During suspension, rents are to be paid into escrow account.
statute_125_530_requires_escrow_payment(Premises) :-
    statute_125_530_rent_suspended(Premises),
    !.

% Under  125.530(5), actions for rent/possession for nonpayment may be maintained if withheld
% rents are not paid into escrow, subject to defenses on lease/contract.
statute_125_530_nonpayment_action_may_be_maintained(Premises) :-
    statute_125_530_rent_suspended(Premises),
    \+ rent_paid_into_escrow(Premises),
    !.

% Placeholders (not present in scenario).
certificate_withheld(_Premises) :- fail.
certificate_suspended(_Premises) :- fail.
owner_had_reasonable_time_to_apply_for_temp_certificate(_Premises) :- fail.
hazard_caused_by_occupant(_Premises) :- fail.
rent_paid_into_escrow(_Premises) :- fail.


/* ============================================================
   MI Comp L  600.5720 (2021)
   Defenses barring judgment for possession for alleged termination of tenancy,
   including retaliatory termination and escrow defenses.
   ============================================================ */

%  600.5720(1): judgment shall not be entered if one or more is established.
statute_600_5720_bar_to_judgment_for_possession(Action) :-
    statute_600_5720_defense_established(Action, _Defense),
    !.

% Enumerate each defense in  600.5720(1)(a)-(g).
statute_600_5720_defense_established(Action, penalty_for_enforcing_rights) :-
    retaliatory_intent(Action, penalty_for_enforcing_rights),
    !.
statute_600_5720_defense_established(Action, penalty_for_health_safety_code_complaint) :-
    retaliatory_intent(Action, penalty_for_health_safety_code_complaint),
    !.
statute_600_5720_defense_established(Action, retribution_for_lawful_act_arising_out_of_tenancy) :-
    retaliatory_intent(Action, retribution_for_lawful_act_arising_out_of_tenancy),
    !.
statute_600_5720_defense_established(Action, government_housing_terminated_without_cause) :-
    terminated_without_cause_in_government_housing(Action),
    !.
statute_600_5720_defense_established(Action, penalty_increase_obligations_then_terminate_for_nonperformance) :-
    penalty_increase_obligations_then_terminate(Action),
    !.
statute_600_5720_defense_established(Action, landlord_breach_excuses_rent_in_nonpayment_case) :-
    possession_claimed_for_nonpayment_of_rent(Action),
    landlord_breach_excuses_payment_of_rent(Action),
    !.
statute_600_5720_defense_established(Action, rent_paid_to_escrow_or_receiver) :-
    possession_claimed_for_nonpayment_of_rent(Action),
    rent_paid_to_escrow_or_receiver(Action),
    !.

%  600.5720(2): Presumptions re retaliatory termination based on timing and official action.
% Encoded generally; scenario provides no such facts.
statute_600_5720_retaliation_presumption(Action, presumption_in_favor_of_defense) :-
    defendant_alleges_retaliatory_termination(Action),
    retaliatory_official_action_within_90_days(Action),
    official_action_not_dismissed_or_denied(Action),
    !.
statute_600_5720_retaliation_presumption(Action, presumption_against_defense) :-
    defendant_alleges_retaliatory_termination(Action),
    ( \+ retaliatory_official_action_within_90_days(Action)
    ; official_action_dismissed_or_denied(Action)
    ),
    !.

% Placeholders for the elements of 600.5720 defenses/presumptions (fail unless facts added).
retaliatory_intent(_Action, _Type) :- fail.
terminated_without_cause_in_government_housing(_Action) :- fail.
penalty_increase_obligations_then_terminate(_Action) :- fail.
possession_claimed_for_nonpayment_of_rent(_Action) :- fail.
landlord_breach_excuses_payment_of_rent(_Action) :- fail.
rent_paid_to_escrow_or_receiver(_Action) :- fail.
defendant_alleges_retaliatory_termination(_Action) :- fail.
retaliatory_official_action_within_90_days(_Action) :- fail.
official_action_not_dismissed_or_denied(_Action) :- fail.
official_action_dismissed_or_denied(_Action) :- fail.


% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Applying the statutes to the scenario (legal reasoning)
% ------------------------------------------------------------

/* The question asks about a specific proposed defense:
   "criminal activity was committed by someone else, and tenant reported it."

   We implement a predicate that would succeed only if the provided statutes
   create a defense with those elements. Under the statutes given, the closest
   concept is retaliatory termination ( 600.5720), but it is limited to
   retaliation for certain protected acts (enforcing rights, reporting landlord
   health/safety code violations, etc.), not simply "reported a third party's crime."
*/

% Helper: tenant's report is of the type protected under  600.5720(1)(b)
% ONLY when it is a complaint to a governmental authority reporting the plaintiff's
% violation of a health/safety code or ordinance.
protected_report_under_600_5720_1b(Action) :-
    defendant_in_action(Tenant, Action),
    tenant_reported_to_law_enforcement(Tenant, Incident),
    report_about(Incident, plaintiff_health_or_safety_code_violation),
    !.

% Helper: tenant attempted to secure/enforce rights under lease/laws under  600.5720(1)(a).
% Modeled narrowly: must be an attempt to enforce tenancy-related rights (not generic crime reporting).
protected_attempt_to_enforce_rights_under_600_5720_1a(Action) :-
    defendant_in_action(_Tenant, Action),
    attempt_to_secure_or_enforce_tenancy_rights(Action),
    !.

attempt_to_secure_or_enforce_tenancy_rights(_Action) :- fail.

% The specific defense described in the question exists under the provided statutes only if:
% (i) the tenant's report is a protected report/act under  600.5720, AND
% (ii) the eviction termination is primarily intended as a penalty/retribution for it.
defense_third_party_crime_reported_recognized_by_given_statutes(Action) :-
    ( protected_report_under_600_5720_1b(Action)
    ; protected_attempt_to_enforce_rights_under_600_5720_1a(Action)
    ),
    % Retaliatory intent must be established under  600.5720(1).
    statute_600_5720_defense_established(Action, _Defense),
    !.

% In this scenario, tenant wants to raise that defense in the eviction action.
tenant_can_raise_defense_in_this_eviction(Action) :-
    defense_third_party_crime_reported_recognized_by_given_statutes(Action),
    !.


% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Final answer predicate (must be deterministic)
% ------------------------------------------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    eviction_action(Action),
    tenant_can_raise_defense_in_this_eviction(Action),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint + initialization
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that criminal activity was committed by someone else, and they reported the criminal activity to law enforcement?
